zh-CN.title: JZDXQ 小程序全面升级
items: 微信小程序现已覆盖聊天、通讯、广场、成长、个性化与常用账户能力
会话和广场优先展示缓存内容，并通过原生角标及时提示新消息与活动奖励
通知渠道会按手机系统智能筛选，后台时停止无意义同步

en.title: A complete JZDXQ Mini Program
items: The WeChat Mini Program now covers chat, contacts, Square, growth, personalization, and everyday account features
Chats and Square render cached content first, with native badges for new messages and claimable rewards
Notification providers are filtered by device platform and background syncing pauses automatically
